text:
The interest rate Monzo pays depends on the type of savings pot you open and whether you have a standard free account or one of Monzo’s paid subscription tiers (Extra, Perks, or Max).

---

### 1. Instant Access Savings Pots
These accounts allow unlimited, instant withdrawals with no minimum deposit. Interest is calculated daily and paid monthly on the 1st:

* **Free account:** **2.80% AER** (variable)
* **Monzo Extra (£3/mo):** **3.15% AER** (variable)
* **Monzo Perks / Plus / Premium (£7/mo):** **3.55% AER** (variable)
* **Monzo Max (£17/mo):** **3.80% AER** (variable)

*(Instant Access Cash ISAs are also available offering matching tax-free variable rates.)*

---

### 2. Select Access Savings Pots
A tiered easy-access pot requiring a £500 minimum deposit. It offers a higher rate as long as you make **2 or fewer withdrawals** per pot per year:

* **Free account:** **3.45% AER** (variable) 
  *(drops to 2.65% if you make 3 or more withdrawals in a year)*
* **Paid Plans (Perks, Max, Plus, Premium):** **3.70% AER** (variable) 
  *(drops to 3.10% if you make 3 or more withdrawals in a year)*

---

### 3. Fixed Rate Pots & Fixed Cash ISAs
If you lock your money away for a set term, you can earn a guaranteed fixed rate:

* **Terms:** Usually 1, 2, or 3 years.
* **Rates:** Up to **4.50% – 5.25% AER** (fixed), paid at maturity.
* **Minimum deposit:** £500.

---

### Good to Know:
* **FSCS Protection:** Eligible deposits in Monzo savings products are protected under the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) up to £120,000 per person.
* **Checking your live rates:** Variable rates adjust when the Bank of England base rate changes. You can always see your specific active rates directly in the app by going to the **Savings / Pots** tab.
